\caption{MCMC diagnostics and cost by method. Upper block (\SOcode{diagnostics\_by\_method.csv}): the share of iterations the convergence gate excluded, the per-iteration largest R-hat and smallest effective sample size over the sampled sites (median over iterations), the mean count of divergent transitions, the share of iterations whose NUTS trees hit the depth cap, and the iterations whose fit raised an exception (they queried a random point instead); the reference methods fit no MCMC model. Lower block (\SOcode{cost\_by\_method\_device.csv}): wall-clock seconds per iteration grouped by the device that ran the iteration, and the summed fit and acquisition hours, a lower bound on the runs' own wall time and, for runs that had a GPU to themselves, on allocated device hours; packed runs shared one device among up to 8, so their summed hours exceed that device's allocation. Do not compare across devices. Packed runs are those the packed launcher's work lists name (\SOcode{pilot-remaining-2026-10-01.txt} and \SOcode{replicate-2026-10-02.txt}, Slurm job name \SOcode{r2d2-packed}): up to 8 runs share one H200 under MPS, and their wall times are not comparable with runs that had a GPU to themselves. Of this snapshot's 320 R2-D2 runs, 302 ran packed and 18 ran one per GPU; no half-Cauchy or reference run is on a packed list. Rows that mix packed and unpacked runs, whose medians therefore blend the two: PA R2-D2 on H200 (72 of 80 packed) and AA R2-D2 on H200 (70 of 80 packed). Cells are named by two initials, structure then parameterization: A or P for additive or product, then A or L for amplitude or lengthscale. Read from snapshot \SOcode{2026-10-02-1420} (scope: 8 families (\SOcode{aligned10}, \SOcode{aligned3}, \SOcode{anti\_aligned}, \SOcode{decoupled}, \SOcode{interaction\_g0.00}, \SOcode{interaction\_g0.25}, \SOcode{interaction\_g0.50} and \SOcode{interaction\_g0.75}), seeds 0--9; 11 methods, 880 of 880 runs complete).}\label{app:so:study:tab:diagnostics}
